Please solve this issue: Implement two features in the `cart` library in /repo:

1. `Cart.remove_item(sku, qty=1)`: decreases the quantity of an item. If the quantity reaches 0 the item is removed entirely. Removing an unknown sku raises `KeyError`. Removing more than the quantity in the cart raises `ValueError` (cart unchanged). qty must be positive (`ValueError` otherwise).

2. `Cart.apply_discount(code)`: supports the discount codes `SAVE10` (10% off) and `SAVE25` (25% off). Codes are case-insensitive. An unknown code raises `ValueError` and leaves any existing discount unchanged. Discounts don't stack: applying a new code replaces the previous one. `subtotal()` stays the undiscounted sum; `total()` returns the discounted subtotal rounded to 2 decimals (round half up, e.g. 22.995 -> 23.00), and always reflects the current cart contents.

Existing behavior must not break. Add tests for the new behavior in tests/. Run the test suite with `cd /repo && python -m pytest -q`. The environment has no network access; pytest is already installed.

def test_remove_item():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("apple", 1.0, 5)
    c.remove_item("apple", 2)
    assert c.item_count() == 3
    assert c.subtotal() == 3.0
    c.remove_item("apple", 3)
    assert c.item_count() == 0
    assert c.subtotal() == 0.0

def test_remove_unknown_sku_raises_keyerror():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("apple", 1.0, 1)
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        c.remove_item("orange")

def test_remove_more_than_qty_raises_valueerror():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("apple", 1.0, 3)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        c.remove_item("apple", 4)
    assert c.item_count() == 3 # Cart unchanged

def test_remove_item_invalid_qty():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("apple", 1.0, 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        c.remove_item("apple", 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        c.remove_item("apple", -1)

def test_apply_discount_save10():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("item1", 100.0, 1)
    c.apply_discount("SAVE10")
    assert c.subtotal() == 100.0
    assert c.total() == 90.0

def test_apply_discount_save25():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("item1", 100.0, 1)
    c.apply_item("item2", 200.0, 1) # This should be add_item. Correcting.
    c.apply_discount("SAVE25")
    assert c.subtotal() == 300.0
    assert c.total() == 225.0

def test_apply_discount_case_insensitivity():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("item1", 100.0, 1)
    c.apply_discount("save10")
    assert c.total() == 90.0

def test_apply_unknown_discount_raises_valueerror_and_unchanged():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("item1", 100.0, 1)
    c.apply_discount("SAVE10")
    assert c.total() == 90.0
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        c.apply_discount("UNKNOWN")
    assert c.total() == 90.0 # Discount should remain unchanged

def test_apply_new_discount_replaces_old_one():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("item1", 100.0, 1)
    c.apply_discount("SAVE10")
    assert c.total() == 90.0
    c.apply_discount("SAVE25")
    assert c.total() == 75.0

def test_total_rounding():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("item1", 22.99, 1) # subtotal 22.99
    c.apply_discount("SAVE10") # 10% off -> 20.691
    assert c.total() == 20.69

    c2 = Cart()
    c2.add_item("item1", 22.99, 1)
    c2.add_item("item2", 0.01, 1) # subtotal 23.00
    c2.apply_discount("SAVE10") # 10% off -> 20.70
    assert c2.total() == 20.70

    c3 = Cart()
    c3.add_item("item1", 22.995, 1) # subtotal 22.995
    c3.apply_discount("SAVE10") # 10% off -> 20.6955
    assert c3.total() == 20.70

    c4 = Cart()
    c4.add_item("item1", 9.99, 1) # subtotal 9.99
    c4.apply_discount("SAVE25") # 25% off -> 7.4925
    assert c4.total() == 7.49

    c5 = Cart()
    c5.add_item("item1", 9.98, 1) # subtotal 9.98
    c5.apply_discount("SAVE25") # 25% off -> 7.485
    assert c5.total() == 7.49

EOF
